# Live OCSP/CRL revocation test vector. Durable windows 2020..2099.
# EC P-256 CA -> leaf (AIA OCSP + CRL DP). crl_stale has nextUpdate in the past.
# scheme_cert: a self-signed certificate whose AIA lists OCSP ldap://x.test/y, file:///etc/passwd and
# HTTP://ocsp.good.test/ and whose CRL distribution points list ldap://x.test/c, ftp://x.test/c.crl
# and https://crl.good.test/ca.crl (only the http/https ones may be returned). Made with
# (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1) openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 -nodes -subj /CN=scheme
# -days 36500 -addext "authorityInfoAccess=OCSP;URI:ldap://x.test/y,OCSP;URI:file:///etc/passwd,OCSP;URI:HTTP://ocsp.good.test/"
# -addext "crlDistributionPoints=URI:ldap://x.test/c,URI:ftp://x.test/c.crl,URI:https://crl.good.test/ca.crl"
# multi_ocsp_cert: a self-signed certificate whose AIA lists OCSP http://a.test/, ldap://x/, http://b.test/,
# http://a.test/ (a repeat), https://c.test/ and http://d.test/, in that order. Made with
# (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1) openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 -nodes -subj /CN=multi
# -days 36500 -addext "authorityInfoAccess=OCSP;URI:http://a.test/,OCSP;URI:ldap://x/,OCSP;URI:http://b.test/,OCSP;URI:http://a.test/,OCSP;URI:https://c.test/,OCSP;URI:http://d.test/"
